Name: Sekiro Fish Bite
Author: Radpotatoe7
Description:
Replaces the (default) fish bite sfx with sekiro perilous attack sfx. (not the exclamation point , i just edited that in , although that is a good idea)
Now it also replaces the fishing complete sound with a parry sound and the fishing failing sound with the death sound.
I really wanted to replace the sound , so when i finally did it , i decided to upload it here so that i could get it in the future again or share it or even if you want to you can dl it.

If you want to use a custom sound for the fish bite , take any .wav file and put it in the sounds folder and name is sekiro.wav and it should replace the fish bite sound ,
Death.wav is for when you fail fishing and Deflect.wav is for when you complete fishing.

If you want to replace any other sound which is not the fish bite , look at the Sound Tweaker (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767) and the Audio modding page (https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio#Audio_data).

Downloads.Description:
Now added a parry sound for completing the fishing minigame , the death sfx when you fail fishing and the perilous attack sfx when fish is there.
All of this can be edited of course.
